jobs.title: Product Lifecycle Management Analyst
jobs.description_text: Summary We're seeking a detail-driven Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Analyst to own the product data and change-control backbone behind Rivet's hardware programs. You'll work across electrical, mechanical, optical, firmware, manufacturing, and quality teams to keep item data, BOMs, and engineering changes accurate and moving through the system without bottlenecks. You'll own the full product data lifecycle—from item and BOM structure through engineering change requests/orders, revision control, and release to manufacturing—so every team is building from the same accurate configuration. The ideal candidate is meticulous, systems-minded, and energized by bringing order and traceability to fast-moving hardware development. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Location & Motion (Inertial Navigation / GNSS)
jobs.description_text: Summary We’re looking for an experienced engineer to own the navigation and positioning stack for Rivet’s head-worn and body-worn systems. You will be responsible for turning inertial and GNSS sensor data into a robust, continuous estimate of position and orientation across challenging real-world environments. This includes sensor calibration and characterization, inertial navigation, GNSS integration, and the estimation algorithms that bring these inputs together. You will work closely with our perception team to define how navigation and visual tracking complement one another and provide a stable experience to downstream systems. This is a highly hands-on role spanning algorithms, embedded software, hardware integration, laboratory testing, and field validation. Responsibilities - Own the end-to-end 9-axis inertial sensing system, including accelerometer, gyroscope, and magnetometer calibration, synchronization, coordinate frames, and attitude estimation. - Develop robust heading and inertial navigation solutions that account for sensor errors, environmental disturbances, temperature variation, and platform effects. - Own GNSS integration and performance, including receiver configuration, raw measurement analysis, signal quality characterization, and resilience to degraded or unreliable positioning environments. - Design and maintain the navigation fusion estimator, combining inertial, GNSS, and other available measurements into a continuous position, velocity, and attitude

jobs.description_text: ABOUT PRODUCTION ENGINEERING Production Engineering is Ramp's infrastructure ownership layer. We exist to make Ramp faster, more reliable, and more scalable — and we do that by being embedded in the problems, not adjacent to them. When a product team struggles with reliability or scalability, that is our struggle. - If reliability or scalability is at risk, we own it. We don't wait to be invited, and we don't ask whose code it is. If a system is slow, if it breaks, if it won't scale — that's ours to lead, regardless of where it lives in the stack. - We go first, and we go fast. When the path isn't obvious, we don't wait for someone else to find it. We move with urgency, propose the solution, align the stakeholders, and stay in until it's done — not until our ticket is closed. - We lead the way. We find the next problem before it finds us. And when we solve it, we don't just fix it for ourselves — the patterns and standards we establish become the foundation the rest of Ramp builds on. That's not a side effect of the job; it's the job. - We stay calibrated. Speed means nothing if we're moving in the wrong direction. This role involves managing supplier quality performance, conducting audits and inspections, driving corrective actions, and working closely with both internal teams and suppliers to resolve quality issues. The Supplier Quality Engineer will also support continuous improvement initiatives, fostering strong supplier relationships, and ensuring that quality requirements are embedded throughout the supply chain. Responsibilities - Supplier Quality Assurance: Develop and implement quality assurance processes and procedures for suppliers to ensure they meet the company's quality standards and regulatory requirements. Monitor supplier quality performance using key metrics (e.g., defect rates, on-time delivery, etc.) and take corrective actions as needed. - Supplier Audits and Assessments: Conduct regular supplier audits, assessments, and inspections to ensure compliance with contractual quality requirements, regulatory standards, and internal procedures. Work with suppliers to address any non-conformances identified during audits. - Root Cause Analysis and Corrective Action: Lead investigations into quality issues related to supplier materials or components. Utilize root cause analysis tools (e.g., 5 Whys, Fishbone Diagram, FMEA) to identify the underlying causes of defects or failures.

jobs.description_text: Job Overview Corsair is Saronic's 24ft autonomous surface vessel, built to carry modular payloads, operate in contested waters, and launch and recover with speed not seen before. Corsair is produced at scale in Austin, TX. Every sensor, module, payload, and harness has to fit, operate, survive extreme dynamic events, and be reconfigured in minutes when a technician meets it at the pier. That engineering problem is yours. You'll own how Corsair's subsystems physically come together from first prototype through a design that can be built at a rate that meets the extreme demands from our customers. Why this role - Your hardware hits the water fast. Designs you release go onto a boat and into open-water testing within weeks, not quarters. - You own the design inside the hull. We're looking for a Cloud and DevOps Engineer with 5–8 years of relevant experience to architect, implement, and maintain secure, scalable, and reliable cloud infrastructure supporting some of the most ambitious space missions in the industry. In this role, you'll provide technical expertise across cloud architecture, infrastructure automation, CI/CD, containerization, cybersecurity, and operational excellence. You'll partner closely with development and operations teams to gather requirements, architect cloud-based DevOps solutions, select appropriate toolsets, and maintain the infrastructure that enables reliable software development and deployment. We're looking for someone who thrives in technically demanding environments, enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges, and is passionate about building secure, automated systems that help engineering teams move faster and more reliably. Citizens only. Must be able to obtain a security clearance. What You'll Actually Do Architect cloud and DevOps solutions. Partner with development and operations teams to gather requirements and architect scalable, secure, and maintainable cloud and DevOps solutions. Evaluate and select modern toolsets based on functionality, security, support, industry best practices, and total cost of ownership. Build and maintain automated delivery infrastructure. Own the enhancement, automation, and ongoing maintenance of CI/CD and software
